notes: Pilot has 15 fixed pairs; no target score is used to change any method, budget or candidate.
P01/MIX01/1-1 is an exposed development episode and not an independent blind test.
Pilot pass means all preregistered predictions and independent scores complete with finite metrics and nonempty per-class query; no superiority criterion or target-dependent selection.
POSTER and Hu cross-backbone bindings are unfinished, not claimed impossible or complete.
ISSL remains stopped; CSIL author binding unavailable; external paths use raw support/query, no DURA.
Group2a r02/r03 failure artifacts are separate, retained and not restarted.
B state fit once at each K and reused across N; query prediction streams batches without fitting query.
